cases.purpose: sysctl -p on fixture files (comments with # and ;, blank lines, spaces around =, a leading - ignore-failure prefix, an unknown key, a line without =), -p with several files and -p with no file named (/etc/sysctl.conf); --system over fixture directories bind-mounted on /etc/sysctl.d, /run/sysctl.d, /usr/lib/sysctl.d and /etc/sysctl.conf, where a same-named file in /etc/sysctl.d overrides /usr/lib/sysctl.d. Only net.ipv4 keys and kernel.domainname are set. Any missing configuration path (the guest lacks /etc/sysctl.conf and /run/sysctl.d) is created as an empty mount point for the side and removed afterwards; a same-named file in /run/sysctl.d overrides /usr/lib/sysctl.d and /usr/local/lib/sysctl.d holds its own file; if any fixture mount fails, --system is not run. Also exercise relative files, syntax-only status, cross-directory lexical order and quiet system output.
cases.comparison: Byte parity of status, stdout and stderr: one line per invocation with its status, stdout and the diagnostic minus any "NAME: line N: " shell-location prefix; /proc/sys values after each load. Each side has fresh network and UTS namespaces, so writes to net.* keys and kernel.domainname change only that side; the initial-namespace values are read with nsenter before and after. The system configuration paths are replaced in the side's mount namespace only.
cases.script:
strip() { /usr/bin/sed -E 's/^[^:]*: line [0-9]+: //' "$1" | /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|'; }
show() { printf '%s status=%s out=' "$1" "$2"; /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|' < /tmp/rf.out; printf ' err='; strip /tmp/rf.err; echo; }
r() { local l=$1; shift; "$@" >/tmp/rf.out 2>/tmp/rf.err; show "$l" $?; }
u() { local g=--clear-groups; [[ $3 ]] && g=--groups=$3
  /usr/bin/setpriv --reuid=2000 --regid=2000 $g -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "$2" >/tmp/rf.out 2>/tmp/rf.err; show "$1" $?; }
cd /tmp; K="net.ipv4.ip_forward net.ipv4.conf.lo.forwarding net.ipv4.conf.all.forwarding kernel.domainname"
v() { local k; for k; do printf '  %s=%s\n' $k "$(< /proc/sys/${k//.//})"; done; }
init() { [[ $(/usr/bin/readlink /proc/1/ns/net) != $(/usr/bin/readlink /proc/self/ns/net) ]] && echo "  initial namespaces distinct: yes" || echo "  initial namespaces distinct: no"
  local k; for k in $K; do printf '  init %s=%s\n' $k "$(/usr/bin/nsenter -t 1 -n -u /usr/bin/cat /proc/sys/${k//.//})"; done; }
init; v $K
printf '# comment\n; also a comment\n\nnet.ipv4.ip_forward = 1\n  net.ipv4.conf.lo.forwarding=1\n-rf.no.such = 3\nkernel.domainname = rf.loaded\n' > /tmp/a.conf
printf 'net.ipv4.ip_forward=0\nrf.no.such = 1\nthis line has no equals\nkernel.domainname=rf.bad\n' > /tmp/bad.conf
printf 'net.ipv4.conf.all.forwarding = 1\n' > /tmp/c.conf
r load-relative sysctl -p a.conf; v $K
printf "bad line without equals\n" > /tmp/syntax-only.conf
r syntax-only sysctl -p syntax-only.conf
r load sysctl -p /tmp/a.conf; v $K
r load-bad sysctl -p /tmp/bad.conf; v $K
r load-two sysctl -p /tmp/c.conf -p /tmp/a.conf; v $K
r load-missing sysctl -p /tmp/missing.conf
r load-quiet sysctl -q -p /tmp/a.conf
S=/tmp/sys; ok=1; made=
for d in /etc/sysctl.d /run/sysctl.d /usr/lib/sysctl.d /usr/local/lib/sysctl.d; do
  [[ -d $d ]] || { /usr/bin/mkdir $d && made+=" $d"; } || ok=0
  /usr/bin/mkdir -p $S$d && /usr/bin/mount --bind $S$d $d || ok=0; done
[[ -e /etc/sysctl.conf ]] || { : > /etc/sysctl.conf && made+=" /etc/sysctl.conf"; }
printf 'net.ipv4.ip_forward = 0\n' > $S/sysctl.conf && /usr/bin/mount --bind $S/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.conf || ok=0
if ((ok)); then
  printf 'net.ipv4.ip_forward = 1\nkernel.domainname = from-usr-lib\n' > /usr/lib/sysctl.d/10-rf.conf
  printf 'net.ipv4.conf.lo.forwarding = 0\n' > /usr/lib/sysctl.d/30-rf.conf
  printf 'kernel.domainname = from-etc\n' > /etc/sysctl.d/10-rf.conf
  printf 'net.ipv4.conf.all.forwarding = 0\n' > /run/sysctl.d/20-rf.conf
  printf 'net.ipv4.conf.lo.forwarding = 1\n' > /run/sysctl.d/30-rf.conf
  printf 'net.ipv4.conf.default.forwarding = 1\n' > /usr/local/lib/sysctl.d/40-rf.conf
  printf "kernel.domainname = lexical-early\n" > /usr/lib/sysctl.d/05-order.conf
  printf "kernel.domainname = lexical-late\n" > /etc/sysctl.d/90-order.conf
  r load-default sysctl -p; v $K; r system sysctl --system; v $K net.ipv4.conf.default.forwarding; r system-quiet sysctl -q --system; v $K; else echo SETUP-FAILED; fi
/usr/bin/umount /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d /run/sysctl.d /usr/lib/sysctl.d /usr/local/lib/sysctl.d 2>/dev/null
for m in $made; do /usr/bin/rm -d -- $m; done
init
